concerns.text: Task T042.5 (`results_aggregator.py`) is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but logically depends on the output of Phase 3 (MoE results) and Phase 4 (SSM results). An aggregator cannot exist in the blocking foundation before the data it aggregates is generated. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' dependency rule.

Tasks T019 (MoE baseline), T020 (MoE Direct-OPD), T029 (SSM baseline), and T030 (SSM Direct-OPD) are listed as implementation tasks but lack explicit dependency on T010 (`reward_computation.py`) and T007/T008/T009 (model loaders). The training loops consume the reward signal and model instances; these dependencies must be explicit to ensure the foundational phase is truly complete before user story implementation begins.

Tasks T043, T044, and T045 (Statistical Analysis) are marked `[X]` (completed) in the text, yet they depend on the output of T024 (MoE results) and T034 (SSM results), which are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). A consumer task cannot be marked complete before its producer tasks are complete. This creates a semantic ordering violation where the analysis phase is 'done' before the experiments generating the data are run.

Task T006.1b (`validate_split.py`) explicitly states 'DEPENDENCY: This task requires the output files from T006.1a'. However, T006.1a is marked `[P]` (parallel-safe). If T006.1a and T006.1b are executed in parallel, T006.1b will fail to find the input files. The `[P]` tag on T006.1a is misleading if it implies it can run independently of T006.1b's execution order, or T006.1b should not be in the same parallel block if it strictly requires T006.1a's output to exist first.

Task T054 (Hash Artifacts) is listed in Phase 6 (Polish) but also appears as T013 in Phase 2. T013 is marked `[P]` and foundational. T054 is marked `[P]` and polish. The duplication and placement in the 'Polish' phase suggests a re-run of hashing after results are generated, but the dependency on T054 (the new T054 in Revision section) to update the state file implies it should run after T024/T034. The ordering of the 'update state' task needs to be clearly after the final result generation, not just in a generic 'Polish' phase.
